en: The image is a vintage black-and-white postcard showing a row of ornate, stepped-gable buildings typical of Flemish architecture. The ground floors house various cafés, restaurants, and hotels, with signs in French and Dutch visible. People in early 20th-century attire walk and sit outside at café tables. At the top, there is the label 'Bruges — Vieilles Maisons de la Grand' Place.'
